Subject: Lift & Align: Action Plan Slate + initial GDoc

Hi team — looping you both in to kick off a lightweight MAP + evaluation slate for Helix. The goal is a one-page, actionable MAP that Helix can use to align stakeholders and for our joint 60-day pilot close plan.

What I’m hoping we can get this week:
- Draft a shared GDoc outline (owners, milestones, success metrics, dependencies). I started a skeleton (link below).
- Put in a first-pass timeline with a proposed pilot start = Jan 11, 2027 and a go/no-go checkpoint at day 30.
- Flag any security/compliance asks they’ll need for ramp (Ben, can you confirm the data retention/KMS notes?).

Attachments: Kickstart_Slides_v1.pptx (high-level kickoff slides), Redwood_MAP_template_v1.gdoc (starter).

GDoc (draft): https://docs.google.com/document/d/1A2B3C-MAP-DRAFT

Quick roles:
- Marissa: lead the MAP doc and stakeholder heatmap
- Ben: technical readiness + eval criteria (sample prompts/metrics)
- I’ll coordinate schedule and executive summary for their procurement team.

Next step: can we have a working draft by end of day Thu (12/09)? I’ll push a short invite for a 30-min kickoff once we have the draft.

Thanks — J

Jasmine Liu
Senior AE, Redwood Inference

On Tue, Dec 7, 2026 at 9:15 AM jasmine_liu@redwood.com wrote:
> Hi team — looping you both in to kick off a lightweight MAP + evaluation slate for Helix...

Thanks — I pulled the skeleton into a co-edit copy and sketched an outline. Link below (working doc). High level items I added:

- Executive summary (1 paragraph)
- Stakeholder heatmap (who owns buy, who needs to be briefed)
- Success criteria / acceptance (product + business KPIs)
- Technical milestones (integration, test data, smoke test)
- Procurement / legal checkpoints and owner

Proposed mini-timeline (first pass):
- Week 0 (Dec 13–17): Finalize MAP + align stakeholders; pre-kickoff readouts
- Week 1 (Jan 11–15): Pilot start — baseline testcases + smoke test
- Day 30 (Feb 9): Go/no-go checkpoint; quality review + cost estimate
- Day 60 (Mar 11): Pilot review & rollout decision

I left notes inline asking for owners and an ETA for any assets they need to share (sample records, SSO config). If we want, I can convert the stakeholder heatmap into a one-slide visual for the kickoff.

GDoc (co-edit): https://docs.google.com/document/d/1A2B3C-MAP-DRAFT/edit?usp=sharing

Marissa

> Thanks — I pulled the skeleton into a co-edit copy...

Quick technical notes from my side:
- Data flow & sandbox: Helix will need a tenant-scoped test dataset and an ingest endpoint. We should request a 3-5GB sample with the expected token distribution.
- Auth: we support SAML + API keys; if they want VPC/private deployment later, note that in the MAP as "dependency: private deployment review".
- Eval matrix: attached a sample eval-matrix-sample.xlsx that maps prompts -> metric (latency, accuracy, hallucination rate, cost/token). Suggest we pick 6 representative prompts for the Day 30 go/no-go.

I’ve added an "engineering readiness" checklist to the doc and called out items that will add 2–3 weeks of work if they need custom adapters.

Ben

Thanks for the clear plan — appreciate the structure. A few items from our side:

- Stakeholders: Sara Thompson (CTO), Tom Liu (Principal ML Eng), Priya Shah (Compliance), Daniel K. (Platform Lead).
- We can provide a 5GB sample dataset by Dec 20. Priya will need the security questionnaire before any data moves; I copied Tom here for technical follow-up.
- Kickoff availability: best times next week are Tue (12/14) 10–12 or Thu (12/16) 1–3pm PT.

I reviewed the draft and left three comments inline on the acceptance criteria — one asks for a clearer definition of "acceptable hallucination rate" (we proposed <= 5% for the demo). Tom, can your team confirm whether that metric works for the six prompts Ben suggested?
